items.title: Taking it back to WHF 2025! 🔊🔙
items.excerpt: Taking it back to WHF 2025! 🔊🔙 @liamwardmusic putting on an absolute masterclass on stage. 🚀 We’re still buzzing from the incredible talent on display last year. Tell us: What was your absolute favorite moment or performance from the festival? 👇🧐
